description: Semantic UI patterns for Axiom. A pattern is not a component: it expands, at authoring time, into ordinary Axiom UI nodes and has no runtime existence. Declare the UX concept; the expansion is explicit, inspectable application semantics.

values.declaration: The pattern declaration is the source of truth. Re-expansion is authoritative and editing a generated node is drift.
values.graph: The expanded graph is the source of truth. The declaration is history and edits are legitimate.

reading.inputs: Every declaration key, its kind, whether it is required, and what the pattern does with it.
reading.inferred: What the pattern works out for itself when an input is absent, and from what.
reading.expansion: The generated tree, part by part: the canonical node kind each part is, and where it sits. Describing only inputs was not enough — an agent composing against a generated tree needs its shape.
reading.generatedIdFormat: How to address a generated node before expansion has happened.
reading.slots: Where caller-supplied semantic content is placed. Slot content is node ids or nested declarations, never markup.

patterns.name: action-bar
patterns.purpose: A row of action controls whose emphasis is inferred from the actions themselves.

actions.purpose: The actions to expose, in order.

primary.purpose: Which action is the primary one.
primary.inferredWhenAbsent: The first action that is not destructive.

arguments.purpose: Arguments per action, keyed by action parameter id.

alignment.purpose: Where the group sits along its axis.

expansion.role: one per action, emphasis from the action

patterns.generatedIdFormat: ui_<instance>_<part>, or ui_<instance>_<part>_<index> for a repeated part

inferred.primary: The first action that is not destructive.

patterns.name: entity-form
patterns.purpose: A form that creates a record in a draft state or edits an existing one addressed by expression, with labels, controls, required markers and a submit action inferred from the graph.

draft.purpose: Create mode: the draft state the controls write into. Its entity supplies every field’s label, control and required status.
draft.inferredWhenAbsent: Required unless `target` is given; exactly one of the two is.

target.purpose: Edit mode: { state, identity } addressing an existing collection member — identity is an expression, usually a route parameter.
target.inferredWhenAbsent: Required unless `draft` is given; exactly one of the two is.

options.purpose: A canonical InputOptionsSource per field id, for a field whose value identifies another record.
options.inferredWhenAbsent: A field with no options source uses the control its declared type implies.

mode.purpose: "create" offers the identity field; "edit" omits it, because an identity is not editable.
mode.inferredWhenAbsent: edit when `target` is given, create when `draft` is. Declaring it is only needed to edit through a draft state.

fields.purpose: Which fields to edit, in order.
fields.inferredWhenAbsent: Every field of the entity, in declaration order, identity included — omitting a required field would produce a form that can never submit.

titleLevel.inferredWhenAbsent: 2 — the level below a page title, so a page and its form do not skip a level.

secondaryActions.purpose: Controls placed beside the submit button.

expansion.role: the form; submitButtonId is the generated submit, and target reads the record being edited
one per field, in entity declaration order; bound to the draft field or to the addressed member’s field
where a refusal of the submit action appears
action-group holding submit and the secondaryActions slot

patterns.generatedIdFormat: ui_<instance>_<part>, or ui_<instance>_<part>_<index> for a repeated part

inferred.draft: Required unless `target` is given; exactly one of the two is.
inferred.target: Required unless `draft` is given; exactly one of the two is.
inferred.options: A field with no options source uses the control its declared type implies.
inferred.mode: edit when `target` is given, create when `draft` is. Declaring it is only needed to edit through a draft state.
inferred.fields: Every field of the entity, in declaration order, identity included — omitting a required field would produce a form that can never submit.
inferred.titleLevel: 2 — the level below a page title, so a page and its form do not skip a level.

patterns.name: entity-list
patterns.purpose: Lists the instances of a collection, one row per member, with optional per-row actions.

fields.purpose: Which fields to display, in order.
fields.inferredWhenAbsent: Every field of the member entity except its identity field.

formats.purpose: Value format per field, where the declared type cannot imply one.
formats.inferredWhenAbsent: number, boolean, date and datetime from the field’s type; currency and percentage are never guessed.

rowArguments.purpose: Arguments per row action, evaluated in the row scope.

emptyMessage.inferredWhenAbsent: An empty state is still generated, with a generic caption.

emptyAction.purpose: An action offered from the empty state, so it says what to do about it.
emptyAction.inferredWhenAbsent: The empty state is a caption only, and validateGraph warns that it offers no recovery.

rowExtra.purpose: Extra semantic content inside each row.

expansion.role: the repeat; ref this id to address the current row
one row, horizontal when wide and stacked when compact
action-group at the end of the row
shown when the collection is empty
the recovery action, when one is given

patterns.generatedIdFormat: ui_<instance>_<part>, or ui_<instance>_<part>_<index> for a repeated part

inferred.fields: Every field of the member entity except its identity field.
inferred.formats: number, boolean, date and datetime from the field’s type; currency and percentage are never guessed.
inferred.emptyMessage: An empty state is still generated, with a generic caption.
inferred.emptyAction: The empty state is a caption only, and validateGraph warns that it offers no recovery.

patterns.name: metric-grid
patterns.purpose: A reflowing grid of prominent summary values.

metrics.purpose: Each metric: a value expression, and optionally a label, format, emphasis and description.
metrics.inferredWhenAbsent: A metric label is inferred from the name of the state its value refers to; a label is required only where the value is not a plain state reference.

expansion.role: the caption, a label and not a heading
the figure, display scale, outside the outline

patterns.generatedIdFormat: ui_<instance>_<part>, or ui_<instance>_<part>_<index> for a repeated part

inferred.metrics: A metric label is inferred from the name of the state its value refers to; a label is required only where the value is not a plain state reference.

patterns.name: page
patterns.purpose: A titled application page with a header region, page-level actions and a content region.

title.purpose: The page heading, and the document’s level-1 heading. A string, or an expression for a title that names the record the page is about.

description.purpose: A caption under the title. A string or an expression.

actions.purpose: Page-level controls, placed in the header.

content.purpose: The page body, in the order given.

expansion.role: action-group beside the title, from the actions slot
content-region landmark, holding the content slot

patterns.generatedIdFormat: ui_<instance>_<part>, or ui_<instance>_<part>_<index> for a repeated part
